title: Microsoft Teams: intelligent call recap for call queue calls in the Queues app on mobile
summary: The briefing passes: the rollout, licensing context and recording controls are supported. The two cited Learn pages give different call-answering prerequisites for automatic recording; the briefing should report both rather than only the group-or-channel wording.

claims.claim: The recording and transcription settings are reached in Teams admin center through Voice > Templates and resources > Templates > Automatic Recording > Add > Call recording > Transcription.
claims.quote: go to Voice > Templates and resources. ... Select Templates. ... Select Automatic Recording as the template type. ... Select Add ... Call recording is enabled by default. ... Transcription is enabled by default.

claims.claim: New-CsAutoRecordingTemplate -Name <template name> -RecordingEnabled $true -TranscriptionEnabled $true creates a template with recording and transcription enabled.
claims.quote: New-CsAutoRecordingTemplate -Name "Customer Service" -Description "Transcription & Recording enabled" -TranscriptionEnabled $true -RecordingEnabled $true ... This example creates a new Auto Recording template that enabled transcription and recording.

claims.claim: Creating the recording template does not assign it; it is applied to queues through a separate assignment.
claims.quote: Assign the template to the call queue ... Select the call queue you want to have automatic recording for. ... Select the automatic recoding template template from the dropdown.

claims.claim: Template assignment is in Teams admin center at Voice > Call queue > call queue > Templates > Automatic recording template.
claims.quote: go to Voice > Call queue. ... Select the call queue you want to have automatic recording for. ... On the Templates tab, scroll to find the Automatic recording template section. ... Select the automatic recoding template template from the dropdown.
